title: Archive-It round-2 batch audit
instructions:
### What to decide
- Review the named candidate, mayoral contest, claimed URL, collection metadata, and archive evidence.
- The machine-proposed grade is context only. No claim is accepted until you code it here.
- If collection metadata identifies the original campaign domain but the claimed URL is an archive-container path, enter the original domain as the corrected URL.
- Code URL type for the URL you accept (the corrected URL when one is entered).

### Evidence grades
- A: an election-period capture of the exact URL identifies the candidate, mayoral campaign, and city.
- B: a contemporaneous official source links the URL and archived content confirms the campaign.
- C: a source supports the URL, but no qualifying campaign capture exists.
- D: domain shape, registration data, or current content provides only a lead.
- Only grades A and B count as strict coverage.

### Scope
- The task contains every Archive-It candidate-domain claim.
- The inclusion-reason field identifies proposed strict positives and the deterministic 10% non-strict audit subset.

questions.label: Does the evidence match the named candidate, mayoral office, and city?
questions.help: Answer yes only when all three identity elements match.

questions.label: Does the evidence belong to this election cycle?
questions.help: Apply the displayed election date and capture window; later candidacies do not qualify.

questions.label: Accept this as a candidate campaign URL claim?
questions.help: Grades A through C may be accepted as claims; only A and B are strict coverage.

questions.label: URL type for the accepted or reviewed URL
Corrected or recovered original campaign URL
